g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: day-ahead forecast of the model trained on power with the edge flows taken out (line), its 80% and 90% bands, and the observed power (dark line); amber: hours inside a hand-filtered switching event. Bottom: the registered fit's hindsight flows on the substation's edges and its outside path. Weeks fixed before any score was read.'
